target_claim: An early internal follicle-state response predicts a later functional/output response.
problem: Many internal-state assays are destructive, so early and late measurements may come from different follicles even when they share donor, region and treatment group.

L0_GROUP_MARGINALS.example: early molecular group mean and later growth group mean

L1_DONOR_LINKED_REPLICATES.example: destructive early assays and later functional readouts from randomized sibling follicles nested within the same donor/region/intervention
L1_DONOR_LINKED_REPLICATES.supports: hierarchical donor-level association if donor identity and replicate allocation are preserved

L2_SAME_UNIT_NONDESTRUCTIVE.example: the same follicle receives a non-destructive early state proxy and is followed to later functional output
L2_SAME_UNIT_NONDESTRUCTIVE.supports: within-follicle temporal prediction for the measured proxy

L3_HUMAN_IN_VIVO_LINKED.example: the same participant/region has an early state measurement and later objective hair output under a prospectively declared intervention
L3_HUMAN_IN_VIVO_LINKED.supports: participant-level temporal association subject to confounding/design limits
L3_HUMAN_IN_VIVO_LINKED.does_not_support: causal recoverability without appropriate intervention/control structure

minimum_for_HF_VAL_002: preserve biological-unit identifiers at the strongest feasible level
state in advance whether the prediction target is follicle-level, donor-level or participant-level
do not fit M1 using early-state values that cannot be linked to the same prediction unit as late output
if destructive assays require sibling replicates, model donor/region/intervention nesting explicitly
report how much variance is within donor versus between donors where data permit

source_context.Tang_2003: same participants had 4-month dermal-papilla IGF-1 assessment and 12-month photographic response; small uncontrolled n=9 study provides participant-level temporal architecture, not follicle-level linkage
source_context.human_organ_model_2026: molecular and functional readouts are temporally structured in a human follicle system, but destructive assays and pooled/group reporting require explicit linkage before early-state predictive covariance can be claimed

falsification: If early-state information adds no out-of-sample prediction once baseline output, donor/region and intervention are included, reject the proposed early-state predictor even if group means move in the expected direction.
claim_boundary: Passing this contract would strengthen temporal prediction evidence. It would still not by itself establish a recoverability threshold, biological hysteresis, or a clinical decision rule.
